verdict.rationale: The catalog says some downstream tools connect "your own account via OAuth" (treg-docs-25, treg-docs-26), and the Search Console use case implies account connection (treg-docs-18). treg stores credentials and injects them server-side (treg-docs-2, treg-docs-10), and offers a `treg health` credential check (treg-gh-4). However, the OAuth flow mechanics are mentioned only in passing, and nothing describes encryption at rest or automatic token refresh. Missing for 10: documented downstream OAuth flow mechanics, encrypted credential vaulting, automatic token refresh, independent corroboration.
